writers-room-evaluate.name: Writers Room — Prose Evaluation
writers-room-evaluate.description: Editorial pass on a Writers Room draft: logline, summary, themes, strengths, issues with excerpts, and concrete suggestions.

writers-room-format.name: Writers Room — Auto-format Prose
writers-room-format.description: Copy-edit paragraphs, dialogue, punctuation, and scene headings in a Writers Room draft. Returns the cleaned prose.

manuscript-reformat.name: Manuscript — Reformat (fix paste artifacts)
manuscript-reformat.description: Repair pasted manuscript formatting, including hard wraps, split drop caps, and broken quotes, while preserving every word.

writers-room-script.name: Writers Room — Adapt to Scene Script
writers-room-script.description: Adapt a Writers Room draft into a screenplay-style scene breakdown with sluglines, action, dialogue, and visual prompts.

writers-room-characters.name: Writers Room — Character Profiles
writers-room-characters.description: Extract a character bible with names, roles, backgrounds, and visual descriptions. Preserve edits and flag gaps in the draft.

writers-room-places.name: Writers Room — Setting / World Bible
writers-room-places.description: Build a location bible by slugline, with palette, era, weather, and recurring details that keep storyboard images consistent.

writers-room-objects.name: Writers Room — Recurring Objects
writers-room-objects.description: Identify recurring objects and describe their appearance and story significance for the continuity bible.

writers-room-cuts.name: Writers Room — Adversarial Cut Pass
writers-room-cuts.description: Find exact passages to cut, classify each cut, and mark the strongest passage to protect during revision.

writers-room-revise.name: Writers Room — Brief-Driven Revision
writers-room-revise.description: Revise a Writers Room draft against an editorial brief, keeping the specified strengths and voice.

writers-room-continue.name: Writers Room — Live Continuation
writers-room-continue.description: Suggest optional continuation beats, prose, or dialogue based on the text around the cursor.

writers-room-cd-bridge.name: Writers Room — Creative Director Bridge
writers-room-cd-bridge.description: Propose a short film treatment from the text around the cursor, with a logline, synopsis, visual style, and scenes.

catalog-extract.name: Catalog Ingest — Grounded Graph
catalog-extract.description: Extract all six catalog ingredient types and source-grounded relationships in one validated response per context-budgeted source chunk.

catalog-ideas-scenes-concepts.name: Catalog Ingest — Ideas / Scenes / Concepts
catalog-ideas-scenes-concepts.description: Find reusable story ideas, dramatic beats, and world concepts in source material for the Creative Ingredients Catalog.

cd-treatment.name: Creative Director — Treatment
cd-treatment.description: Plan a long-form generated-video project: write the logline, synopsis, and scene-by-scene treatment.

cd-evaluate.name: Creative Director — Scene Evaluation
cd-evaluate.description: Evaluate a freshly-rendered scene against the project style spec and scene intent. Reads multi-frame samples to judge intent across the full clip timeline.

cd-plan.name: Creative Director — Production Plan
cd-plan.description: Turn a production directive into an ordered plan of creative tool calls with dependencies.

cos-task-enhance.name: CoS Task Enhancement
cos-task-enhance.description: Research the codebase and expand a brief task description into an executable agent prompt

memory-evaluate.name: Memory Evaluation
memory-evaluate.description: Evaluate agent output to extract useful memories

brain-weekly-review.name: Brain Weekly Review
brain-weekly-review.description: Generate weekly review and open loops analysis

soul-contradiction-detector.name: Soul Contradiction Detector
soul-contradiction-detector.description: Analyze soul documents for internal contradictions and inconsistencies

soul-enrichment.name: Soul Enrichment
soul-enrichment.description: Generate the next follow-up question to enrich soul documents (plain-text question, not JSON)

soul-enrichment-process.name: Soul Enrichment Processor
soul-enrichment-process.description: Process enrichment answers for inclusion in soul documents

soul-test-generator.name: Soul Test Generator
soul-test-generator.description: Generate behavioral tests from soul content

soul-test-scorer.name: Soul Test Scorer
soul-test-scorer.description: Score AI responses against expected soul behavioral patterns

values-alignment-scorer.name: Values-Alignment Scorer
values-alignment-scorer.description: Grade whether a twin response is consistent with the user's ranked values hierarchy

adversarial-boundary-scorer.name: Adversarial Boundary Scorer
adversarial-boundary-scorer.description: Grade whether a twin held or breached a stated boundary under an adversarial manipulation attempt

multi-turn-consistency-scorer.name: Multi-Turn Consistency Scorer
multi-turn-consistency-scorer.description: Grade whether a twin stayed consistent across a multi-turn conversation

soul-writing-analyzer.name: Soul Writing Analyzer
soul-writing-analyzer.description: Extract communication patterns from writing samples

twin-trait-extractor.name: Twin Trait Extractor
twin-trait-extractor.description: Extract quantitative personality traits from twin documents

twin-confidence-analyzer.name: Twin Confidence Analyzer
twin-confidence-analyzer.description: Analyze completeness and confidence of twin personality definition

twin-import-analyzer.name: Twin Import Analyzer
twin-import-analyzer.description: Extract personality insights from imported external data

twin-interview-analyze.name: Twin Interview Analyzer
twin-interview-analyze.description: Extract traits and suggested documents from a pasted personality assessment or interview transcript

twin-spoken-written-compare.name: Twin Spoken-vs-Written Comparison
twin-spoken-written-compare.description: Compare a person's spoken transcript against their writing samples and surface communication-style differences

twin-image-identity-analyze.name: Twin Image Identity Analyzer
twin-image-identity-analyze.description: Analyze a photo of a person and extract visible appearance and self-presentation descriptors for their digital twin

model-personality-profile.name: Model Personality Self-Profile
model-personality-profile.description: Blind single-prompt introspective self-evaluation returning a structured personality trait map

model-personality-alignment-scorer.name: Model Personality Alignment Scorer
model-personality-alignment-scorer.description: Score how well a model's self-reported personality aligns with the digital twin's stored trait profile

pipeline-idea-expansion.name: Pipeline — Idea / Beat Sheet
pipeline-idea-expansion.description: Expand an issue or episode idea into a beat sheet with a logline, theme, setting, and new characters.

pipeline-prose.name: Pipeline — Prose Draft
pipeline-prose.description: Draft an 800–1,500 word short story from an issue or episode beat sheet, with scene headings for later adaptations.

pipeline-comic-script.name: Pipeline — Comic Book Script
pipeline-comic-script.description: Adapt a prose draft into a page-by-page, panel-by-panel comic script with captions, dialogue, and sound effects.

pipeline-teleplay.name: Pipeline — TV Teleplay
pipeline-teleplay.description: Adapt a prose draft into an episode teleplay with sluglines, action, dialogue, and act breaks.

pipeline-editorial-analysis.name: Pipeline — Editorial Reader-Emotion Analysis
pipeline-editorial-analysis.description: Map an issue’s emotional journey, plot tension, character arcs, and protagonist for the Editorial Roadmap.

pipeline-judge-issue.name: Pipeline — Calibrated Issue Quality Judge
pipeline-judge-issue.description: Score a drafted issue against its writing brief across nine craft and continuity dimensions, citing its strongest and weakest lines.

pipeline-judge-compare.name: Pipeline — Head-to-Head Issue Comparison
pipeline-judge-compare.description: Compare two drafted issues, pick the stronger one for the series ranking, and quote the passage that decided it.

pipeline-judge-foundation.name: Pipeline — Foundation Quality Judge
pipeline-judge-foundation.description: Assess a series before drafting. Score the world, cast, structure, and voice, and suggest a concrete repair for each weak area.

pipeline-character-foundation.name: Pipeline — Character Foundation
pipeline-character-foundation.description: Develop the core cast’s motivations, voices, relationships, visual identities, and arcs before outlining, then reconcile them with the plan.

pipeline-foundation-repair.name: Pipeline — Foundation Repair
pipeline-foundation-repair.description: Repair a series’ weakest cast or voice elements while preserving established identities and story structure.

pipeline-panel-editor.name: Pipeline — Reader Panel: The Editor
pipeline-panel-editor.description: Review the series from a developmental editor’s perspective, citing momentum, scene craft, and whether the ending is earned.

pipeline-panel-genre-reader.name: Pipeline — Reader Panel: The Genre Reader
pipeline-panel-genre-reader.description: Review the series from an avid genre reader’s perspective, citing what makes it hard to put down or easy to stop reading.

pipeline-panel-writer.name: Pipeline — Reader Panel: The Writer
pipeline-panel-writer.description: Review the series from a working novelist’s perspective, citing structure, scene beats, setups, and payoffs.

pipeline-panel-first-reader.name: Pipeline — Reader Panel: The First Reader
pipeline-panel-first-reader.description: Review the series from a first reader’s perspective, citing emotional reactions, memorable scenes, and interest in the next book.

pipeline-reverse-outline.name: Pipeline — Reverse Outline (scene segmentation + plotline tagging)
pipeline-reverse-outline.description: Map the drafted manuscript’s plotlines and scenes, tagging where each scene happens, whose viewpoint it uses, and what it advances.

pipeline-continuity-bible.name: Pipeline — Continuity Bible (established-facts ledger)
pipeline-continuity-bible.description: Build a continuity bible of concrete facts from canon and drafted prose, including chronology, character traits, possessions, and knowledge.

pipeline-extract-scenes.name: Pipeline — Extract Scenes from TV Teleplay
pipeline-extract-scenes.description: Extract renderable storyboard scenes from the sluglines of a formatted teleplay, using canonical names and settings.

pipeline-audio-cues.name: Pipeline — Audio Cue Planner
pipeline-audio-cues.description: Turn an episode’s emotional beats into ordered music cues with labels and self-contained text-to-music prompts.

story-builder-idea-expand.name: Story Builder — Idea Expand
story-builder-idea-expand.description: Expand a one-line story idea into a working title, logline, and premise for the Story Builder.

story-builder-reader-map.name: Story Builder — Reader Map
story-builder-reader-map.description: Plan the audience’s experience across a series using hooks, payoffs, emotional beats, and cliffhangers.

story-builder-reader-map-refine.name: Story Builder — Reader Map Refine
story-builder-reader-map-refine.description: Revise the audience experience map using free-text feedback and summarize the changes and rationale.

story-builder-arc-refine.name: Story Builder — Plot Arc Refine
story-builder-arc-refine.description: Revise the plot arc’s logline, summary, protagonist arc, and themes using feedback while keeping the season plan.

pipeline-arc-overview.name: Pipeline — Series Arc Overview
pipeline-arc-overview.description: Plan the series’ logline, themes, and protagonist arc, with a multi-season outline, ending hooks, and episode targets.

pipeline-season-episodes.name: Pipeline — Season Episode Breakdown
pipeline-season-episodes.description: Outline one season’s episodes from its opening state to its ending hook, respecting series continuity and the protagonist’s larger arc.

pipeline-arc-verify.name: Pipeline — Arc Verification
pipeline-arc-verify.description: Review an authored series arc for continuity, dropped subplots, weak endings, and imbalances across seasons.

pipeline-arc-resolve.name: Pipeline — Arc Verification Auto-Resolve
pipeline-arc-resolve.description: Resolve verification findings in the story arc and season outlines while preserving the author’s work and established canon.

pipeline-volume-verify.name: Pipeline — Volume / Season Verification
pipeline-volume-verify.description: Check one volume’s internal arc, beat escalation, cast, worldbuilding, and continuity with neighboring volumes.

pipeline-beat-continuity.name: Pipeline — Whole-Manuscript Beat Continuity
pipeline-beat-continuity.description: Check drafted beat sheets for dropped setups, duplicated firsts, continuity breaks, and drift from the intended ending.

pipeline-beat-continuity-resolve.name: Pipeline — Beat Continuity Auto-Resolve
pipeline-beat-continuity-resolve.description: Resolve whole-manuscript continuity findings by rewriting only the affected issue beat sheets.

pipeline-script-verify.name: Pipeline — Comic Script Verification
pipeline-script-verify.description: Review one issue’s comic script before art for panel renderability, flow, structure, continuity, and page turns.

pipeline-self-improve.name: Pipeline — Self-Improvement Diagnosis
pipeline-self-improve.description: Diagnose an opted-in Series Autopilot run after it finishes, distinguishing an editorial problem from a pipeline defect.

pipeline-observer.name: Pipeline — Observing Orchestrator
pipeline-observer.description: Diagnose abnormal steps during an opted-in Series Autopilot run and dispatch high-confidence pipeline defects for repair.

pipeline-manuscript-completeness.name: Pipeline — Manuscript Completeness
pipeline-manuscript-completeness.description: Review a drafted manuscript for missing scenes or beats, unfinished arcs, thin characterization, pacing, and continuity gaps.

pipeline-manuscript-fix.name: Pipeline — Manuscript Fix
pipeline-manuscript-fix.description: Propose a targeted replacement for a quoted passage to resolve one manuscript finding while preserving the author’s voice.

pipeline-volume-cover-concepts.name: Pipeline — Volume Cover Concepts
pipeline-volume-cover-concepts.description: Propose front and back cover art for one volume as scene descriptions ready for image generation.

pipeline-comic-cover-concepts.name: Pipeline — Comic Issue Cover Concepts
pipeline-comic-cover-concepts.description: Propose front and back cover art for one comic issue as scene descriptions ready for image generation.

pipeline-series-title-logo.name: Pipeline — Series Title / Logo Design
pipeline-series-title-logo.description: Design series masthead and title typography using the title, logline, style notes, and universe influences.

pipeline-series-generate.name: Pipeline — Generate Series Concepts
pipeline-series-generate.description: Generate distinct series concepts with a name, premise, emotional arc, and conflict that can sustain the story.

pipeline-series-concept-judge.name: Pipeline — Series Concept Judge (forced pick)
pipeline-series-concept-judge.description: Rank generated series concepts and pick the strongest for freshness, stakes, and a conflict that can sustain the story.

pipeline-series-voice-discover.name: Pipeline — Discover Series Voice
pipeline-series-voice-discover.description: Write the same scene beat in distinct registers so the author can choose a voice for the series.

pipeline-comic-panel-image-prompt.name: Pipeline — Comic Panel Image Prompt
pipeline-comic-panel-image-prompt.description: Expand one comic panel’s visual description into an image prompt using neighboring panels and the scene’s text.

pipeline-storyboard-image-prompt.name: Pipeline — Storyboard Scene Image Prompt
pipeline-storyboard-image-prompt.description: Expand a storyboard scene into an image prompt consistent with its slugline and neighboring scenes.

pipeline-comic-page-refine-render.name: Pipeline — Comic Page Refine Render
pipeline-comic-page-refine-render.description: Apply a targeted author correction to an already rendered comic page for image-to-image revision.

universe-character-expand.name: Universe — Expand Character Profile
universe-character-expand.description: Fill gaps in a character’s motivations, relationships, mannerisms, and visual identity while preserving authored details.

universe-canon-entry-expand.name: Universe — Expand Place / Object Entry
universe-canon-entry-expand.description: Fill gaps in a canon place or object’s description, visual details, or significance while preserving authored details.

importer-classify.name: Importer — Content-Type Classification
importer-classify.description: Classify the opening of an imported work as a short story, novel, screenplay, or comic script.

importer-canon-extract.name: Importer — Universe Canon Extraction
importer-canon-extract.description: Extract a canon roster of characters, places, and objects from an imported work.

importer-arc-extract.name: Importer — Series Arc Extraction
importer-arc-extract.description: Extract a finished work’s logline, themes, protagonist arc, emotional shape, and season outline.

importer-issue-proposal.name: Importer — Issue Proposal
importer-issue-proposal.description: Split an imported work into proposed pipeline issues, using source headers and verbatim excerpts.

pipeline-character-refine.name: Pipeline — Differentiate One Character
pipeline-character-refine.description: Differentiate one character’s physical description from the rest of the cast while preserving evidence and first appearance.

pipeline-character-differentiate-cast.name: Pipeline — Differentiate Cast (Universe-Wide)
pipeline-character-differentiate-cast.description: Differentiate the cast’s visual descriptions as a group while preserving locked character records.

pipeline-canon-describe-from-prose.name: Pipeline — Describe Nouns From Prose
pipeline-canon-describe-from-prose.description: Fill missing canon descriptions from manuscript evidence and identify nouns that the prose leaves underdescribed.

pipeline-editorial-info-dumping.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Info-dumping
pipeline-editorial-info-dumping.description: Flag exposition dumps and propose specific ways to dramatize or trim them.

pipeline-editorial-interiority.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Protagonist interiority
pipeline-editorial-interiority.description: Flag gaps in a viewpoint character’s thinking, goals, emotional responses, or decisions.

pipeline-editorial-chekhov.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Chekhov's guns (setups & payoffs)
pipeline-editorial-chekhov.description: Find setups that never pay off and payoffs that were never planted, using the draft and the reader’s map.

pipeline-editorial-premature-reveal.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Premature reveal (spoiler leak)
pipeline-editorial-premature-reveal.description: Flag passages that disclose a reveal too early while leaving deliberate foreshadowing intact.

pipeline-editorial-world-unforeshadowed-.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Unforeshadowed solution
pipeline-editorial-world-unforeshadowed-.description: Flag decisive solutions that rely on world rules, powers, or objects the reader has yet to encounter.

pipeline-editorial-world-cost-free-power.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Cost-free power
pipeline-editorial-world-cost-free-power.description: Flag decisive uses of magic, technology, or abilities without the cost or limitation established by the story.

pipeline-editorial-comic-page-turn.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Comic page-turn beats
pipeline-editorial-comic-page-turn.description: Flag comic reveals or cliffhangers that become visible before their intended page turn.

pipeline-editorial-dead-metaphor.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Dead / mixed metaphor & overwriting
pipeline-editorial-dead-metaphor.description: Flag dead or mixed metaphors, lightly disguised clichés, and overwrought prose.

pipeline-editorial-opening-start.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Weak opening (wrong start)
pipeline-editorial-opening-start.description: Flag clichéd or mistimed story and chapter openings, including scenes that start before the interesting moment.

pipeline-editorial-mirror-description.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Mirror self-description
pipeline-editorial-mirror-description.description: Flag mirror-based descriptions that pause the story to list a character’s appearance.

pipeline-editorial-dialogue-pleasantries.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Empty greeting / small-talk openings
pipeline-editorial-dialogue-pleasantries.description: Flag scene openings with greetings or small talk that carry little information, tension, or subtext.

pipeline-editorial-kill-your-darlings.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Kill your darlings
pipeline-editorial-kill-your-darlings.description: Identify showpiece passages, digressions, and favorite lines that stall a scene and could be cut.

pipeline-editorial-endings-cliffhanger.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Chapter-ending cliffhangers
pipeline-editorial-endings-cliffhanger.description: Flag chapter endings that settle too neatly and suggest unresolved beats that pull the reader onward.

pipeline-editorial-sensory-balance.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Sensory balance
pipeline-editorial-sensory-balance.description: Find scenes that rely heavily on sight or lack concrete sensory detail, and name the missing senses.

pipeline-editorial-white-room.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: White-room / ungrounded scene
pipeline-editorial-white-room.description: Find scenes with dialogue or action but too little setting, blocking, or spatial grounding.

pipeline-editorial-summary-not-scene.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Narrated summary where a scene belongs
pipeline-editorial-summary-not-scene.description: Flag decisive story beats that pass in summary and identify where to dramatize them in a scene.

pipeline-editorial-interiority-balance.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Interiority balance (description vs. POV reaction)
pipeline-editorial-interiority-balance.description: Find visually detailed scenes where the viewpoint character’s responses, emotions, or thoughts are missing.

pipeline-editorial-arc-transitions.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Character-arc transitions
pipeline-editorial-arc-transitions.description: Flag major character changes that happen without believable steps in the story.

pipeline-editorial-timeline-contradictio.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Timeline / canon contradiction
pipeline-editorial-timeline-contradictio.description: Find canon or chronology contradictions, such as a shifted age, impossible sequence, or character returning without explanation.

pipeline-editorial-fact-accuracy.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Research / fact accuracy
pipeline-editorial-fact-accuracy.description: Check grounded fiction against the author’s fact reference for geography, historical, technological, or physical errors.

pipeline-editorial-character-consistency.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Character consistency (unearned personality shift)
pipeline-editorial-character-consistency.description: Flag contradictions in established traits, unexplained changes in behavior, and knowledge a character has not earned.

pipeline-editorial-object-motivation.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Unmotivated object interaction
pipeline-editorial-object-motivation.description: Flag moments when a character treats an object as important without an established attachment or on-page setup.

pipeline-editorial-object-backstory.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Attachment backstory consistency
pipeline-editorial-object-backstory.description: Find contradictions between the origin of a character’s attachment to an object and their established background.

pipeline-editorial-object-weight-proport.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Object narrative-weight proportionality
pipeline-editorial-object-weight-proport.description: Flag overdeveloped minor objects or major objects whose significance the story has yet to establish.

pipeline-editorial-style-conformance.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Style-guide conformance
pipeline-editorial-style-conformance.description: Find departures from the series style guide’s narrative tense, point of view, or content rating.

pipeline-pov-rewrite.name: Pipeline — Perspective Rewrite (alternate POV)
pipeline-pov-rewrite.description: Rewrite an issue’s passage from another character’s point of view as an exploratory revision.

pipeline-pov-analysis.name: Pipeline — Perspective Rewrite Analysis (what we learn)
pipeline-pov-analysis.description: Compare a passage with its alternate-viewpoint rewrite and suggest useful details or edits to carry back into the original.

pipeline-editorial-telling-emotion.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Telling-not-showing emotion
pipeline-editorial-telling-emotion.description: Flag named emotions that would land better through action, sensation, or subtext.

pipeline-editorial-interiority-register.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Interiority register
pipeline-editorial-interiority-register.description: Flag inner thoughts that sound like the author’s essay voice or lose the character’s individual register.

pipeline-editorial-on-the-nose.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: On-the-nose / subtext-free dialogue
pipeline-editorial-on-the-nose.description: Find dialogue that states its subtext or makes characters repeat information they already share.

pipeline-editorial-reported-speech.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Reported speech where a quoted line belongs
pipeline-editorial-reported-speech.description: Find decisive speech that is summarized or reported and identify the moment that would benefit from a quoted line.

pipeline-editorial-voice-distinctiveness.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Character voice distinctiveness
pipeline-editorial-voice-distinctiveness.description: Flag interchangeable dialogue voices and lines that conflict with a character’s established speech patterns.

pipeline-editorial-voice-consistency.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Narrative voice / tone consistency
pipeline-editorial-voice-consistency.description: Flag unexplained changes in the narrator’s tone across issues while allowing purposeful shifts.

pipeline-editorial-plot-structure.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Plot structure & momentum
pipeline-editorial-plot-structure.description: Find stalled scenes, sagging stakes, dropped subplots, convenient resolutions, and other plot structure problems.

pipeline-editorial-head-hopping.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Head-hopping / POV discipline
pipeline-editorial-head-hopping.description: Flag limited-viewpoint scenes that enter another character’s thoughts or switch viewpoint without a break.

pipeline-editorial-climax-agency.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Climax / resolution power (passive protagonist at the climax)
pipeline-editorial-climax-agency.description: Check whether the climax hinges on the protagonist’s hardest choice and pays off the story’s problem and themes.

pipeline-editorial-reaction-proportional.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Emotional beat proportionality (reactions vs event magnitude)
pipeline-editorial-reaction-proportional.description: Flag emotional responses that underplay a major event or overstate a minor one, including events left unprocessed across issues.

pipeline-editorial-secondary-arc.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Secondary-character arcs (recurring non-POV cast)
pipeline-editorial-secondary-arc.description: Check whether recurring non-viewpoint characters change meaningfully or remain static for a clear story purpose.

pipeline-editorial-theme-coherence.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Theme coherence / thematic throughline
pipeline-editorial-theme-coherence.description: Trace how the draft sets up, complicates, and pays off its themes, and surface strong emergent themes.

pipeline-editorial-unmodeled-names.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Unmodeled proper nouns used as character names
pipeline-editorial-unmodeled-names.description: Find apparent character names missing from canon and suggest which names to add or leave anonymous.

pipeline-editorial-eyeline-match.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Storyboard eyeline match
pipeline-editorial-eyeline-match.description: Flag storyboard shots with mismatched eyelines or inconsistent screen direction across cuts.

pipeline-editorial-appearance-continuity.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Storyboard appearance / prop continuity
pipeline-editorial-appearance-continuity.description: Find unexplained changes in wardrobe, props, lighting, or setting across storyboard shots.

pipeline-editorial-comic-prose-sync.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Comic ↔ prose synchronization (hybrid issues)
pipeline-editorial-comic-prose-sync.description: Compare prose narration with comic pages and flag substantive differences in plot, dialogue, or chronology.

pipeline-editorial-pacing-escalation-cur.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Pacing / intensity escalation curve
pipeline-editorial-pacing-escalation-cur.description: Track dramatic intensity across issues and flag flat escalation, early peaks, and stalled or falling stakes.

pipeline-editorial-arc-regression.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Character-arc regression / premature closure
pipeline-editorial-arc-regression.description: Flag arcs that regress without purpose, circle back without payoff, or resolve too soon.

pipeline-editorial-adversarial-cuts.name: Pipeline — Editorial Check: Adversarial cuts (prose tightening)
pipeline-editorial-adversarial-cuts.description: Identify exact candidate cuts, classify each cut, and mark the strongest and weakest passages.

fableloom-weave-episode.name: FableLoom — Weave Episode Graph
fableloom-weave-episode.description: Weave a complete interactive episode into single-shot scenes with decision paths, endings, and media direction.

fableloom-outline-episode.name: FableLoom — Draft Episode Beat Outline
fableloom-outline-episode.description: Outline an interactive episode’s story beats, transitions, audience choices, and endings before drafting scenes or producing media.

fableloom-branch-node.name: FableLoom — Branch a Scene
fableloom-branch-node.description: Turn a single-shot scene into a decision point and draft new paths with playback and media direction.

fableloom-generate-series-plan.name: FableLoom — Draft Series Plan
fableloom-generate-series-plan.description: Draft a FableLoom series arc, plot points, and side quests without rewriting episode scene graphs.

fableloom-feedback-episode.name: FableLoom — Apply Episode Feedback
fableloom-feedback-episode.description: Apply an author’s revision to an interactive episode while preserving its existing scene and path identities.

fableloom-feedback-series-plan.name: FableLoom — Apply Series Plan Feedback
fableloom-feedback-series-plan.description: Apply author feedback to a FableLoom series arc, plot points, and side quests without changing episode scenes.

fableloom-play-turn.name: FableLoom — Play Turn
fableloom-play-turn.description: Narrate an interactive reading turn and decide whether the reader takes an available path or stays in the scene.

fableloom-reformat-scenes.name: FableLoom — Reformat Scenes
fableloom-reformat-scenes.description: Convert interactive scenes between narrated prose and teleplay while preserving story beats, characters, choices, and scene identities.

fableloom-review.name: FableLoom — Episode Review
fableloom-review.description: Review a branching episode for choice clarity, branch coherence, scene craft, ending payoff, and canon fit.

fableloom-review-episode-outline.name: FableLoom — Review Episode Beat Outline
fableloom-review-episode-outline.description: Story-editor review of one episode's pre-teleplay log-line arc, branch consequences, continuity, audience contract, endings, and handoff to adjacent episodes.

fableloom-review-series-plan.name: FableLoom — Review Series Plan
